thread:
Ivy: Need a rapid one-pager + short launch post to push the Secure Deploy workshop (VPC + on-prem). Audience: compliance buyers, field AEs, SEs. Must include: SLA snapshot, inbound form fields, benchmark headline, and two CTAs (workshop scheduling + webinar RSVP).

Noah: I'll draft the one-pager hero + 2-line subhead. Suggest: "Predictable inference for regulated apps 1 with clear routing and SLAs."

Rita: I'll pull the quantized L2-13b perf numbers and make a tight benchmark sentence. Use conservative phrasing and footnote test harness.

Samir: I'll build the HubSpot form. Proposed fields: deployment_choice (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), compliance_needs (SOC2/ISO/HIPAA), data_residency (region), priority_sla (checkbox). Will wire routing rules: Private or HIPAA -> Enterprise AE queue; priority_sla -> urgent tag + Slack notify.

FormBot: form created -> secure-deploy-interest-2026; utm_campaign=secure-workshop-2026 :white_check_mark:

Rita: Bench snippet (draft): "Dedicated configs show ~2x higher steady throughput and ~1.4x lower token cost vs Hosted for sustained production workloads (quantized L2-13b)." Footnote: test harness, seq length distribution, quant profile.

LegalBot: Marketing note: avoid absolute uptime claims. Use "SLA-backed" and link to SLA terms. Compliance blurb approved: "Supports SOC2 and ISO-aligned controls; Private/on-prem deployments available for data residency and regulatory needs."

Ivy: Timeline: first drafts by EOD tomorrow. Webinar slots: Wed 9am PT (preferred) or Thu 1pm PT. I'll schedule a 30m review after drafts land.

Noah: Will include a tiny AE cheat-sheet (5-sentence pitch + 3 qualification Qs) and the routing checklist.

Samir: I'll add hidden campaign tags for conversion tracking and a mapping doc in Confluence.

Ivy: Great. Keep messages short here if you hit blockers. Thanks team. :rocket:
